always_on.name: Google AI Pro for students
always_on.note: Free for 12 months for US college students 18+, verified with SheerID. Worth $239.88 at the monthly price. Redeem by Dec 31; a card is required and it renews at $19.99 unless cancelled.

always_on.name: GitHub Copilot Student
always_on.note: Free Copilot Pro while you remain eligible (verified student status). Copilot Free is also free for individuals.

always_on.name: JetBrains
always_on.note: 40% off personal subscriptions for former students; 50% off IDEs and JetBrains AI for startups for up to 5 years.

always_on.name: Modal
always_on.note: $30/month of free compute credits on the Starter plan, plus up to $10k for academics.

always_on.name: Lambda
always_on.note: Up to $5,000 in cloud credits for qualifying researchers, by application.

always_on.name: RunPod
always_on.note: Referral credit of $5–$500 after a first $10 spend, plus $1k–$25k in startup credits by application.

always_on.name: DigitalOcean
always_on.note: $200 in credit for the first 60 days on a new account.

always_on.name: n8n
always_on.note: Startup plan: 50% off Business for companies under 20 employees.

always_on.name: Ideogram / Leonardo / Playground / Midjourney / Suno
always_on.note: Up to 33%, 20%, 20%, 20% and 20% off respectively for paying annually — not a Black Friday deal, but it never expires.

always_on.name: Otter.ai / Fireflies / Fathom
always_on.note: Annual billing is the discount here: 51%, 44% and 25% respectively, charged every day of the year.
